description: Move a task to a new state. Only the transitions in the specification's lifecycle table are accepted, and a task that requires review cannot be completed here. A task whose review no decision has closed, or a successor that carries one on, is not declined (-32602).

from.description: This server acts as agent:assistant: it fills this in, and refuses a call that names anyone else.

progress_note.description: Short note on what changed, kept in the task's history.

state.description: The state to move the task to. Only the transitions in SPECIFICATION.md 8.1 are legal from the task's current state; others are refused with -32602. A review opens with chap.review.request, or with chap.task.complete on a task that requires one, so 'review_requested' is not a target here. A task marked review_required cannot be moved to 'completed' here: submit the output with chap.task.complete, which opens the review.

name: chap.task.update
title: Change task state
